_README: Every file under public/ must appear here, matched by exact path or by a glob; an exact path wins. `npm run lint` fails on any file that does not. `ship: false` marks an asset that may not be published — the licence check run with --publish fails while any of those are still in the tree. This file exists because the project already lost a full voice-over to a licence nobody checked.

public/vo/six-wives.wav.source: Generated by tools/tts.py (`npm run tts -- six-wives`), Kokoro-82M
public/vo/six-wives.wav.note: Kokoro-82M is Apache-2.0 and runs locally, so the read carries a commercial licence. Replaced a free-plan ElevenLabs render that did not. Regenerating rewrites the word timings, so both Tudor shorts re-cut themselves against the new read — check their beats after, which is what docs/vo-licensing.md describes.

public/sfx/*.wav.note: Synthesised from numpy rather than sourced, so there is no provenance to verify: the only thing to audit is tools/sfx.py. Deterministic — re-running rewrites all seven byte for byte. Replaced free-plan ElevenLabs renders, which carried no commercial licence.

public/kit/pd/henry/*.png.source: Henry VIII, full length, after Hans Holbein the Younger, Walker Art Gallery — via Wikimedia Commons
public/kit/pd/henry/*.png.note: Cut into rig parts by tools/cut.py. The painter died in 1543; a faithful photograph of a two-dimensional public-domain work carries no new copyright.

public/kit/pd/anne/*.png.source: Anne of Cleves, Hans Holbein the Younger, Louvre — via Wikimedia Commons
public/kit/pd/anne/*.png.note: Cut into rig parts by tools/cut.py.

public/kit/pd/*.jpg.source: Tiled from the background of the Henry VIII painting above
public/kit/pd/*.jpg.note: Set dressing derived from the same public-domain scan.

public/vo/*.wav.source: Synthesised locally with Kokoro-82M (hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) via tools/tts.py
public/vo/*.wav.note: Apache-2.0 model run on our own machine: no per-character cost and no terms page that can change under a published video. The exact entry for six-wives.wav above overrides this one until that file is replaced.

public/fonts/*.source: Copied unmodified from the Debian fonts-liberation (Liberation 2.1) and fonts-inter (Inter 4.0) packages, with each package's copyright file as LICENSE-*.txt beside them
public/fonts/*.note: The faces the cloud renderer was already substituting for Arial Black, Arial, Georgia and Helvetica Neue, pinned so that every machine draws what QA measured. OFL allows bundling with the project; only selling the fonts on their own, or a modified copy under the reserved names, is ruled out. See src/fonts.ts.

public/music/space.mp3.note: The page carries the author's own notice dedicating the file to the public domain. Bed for Space shorts. First 45 s, levelled to -26 LUFS and re-encoded by tools/music.sh (`npm run music`). Licence read on the track's page on 2026-11-10.

public/fonts/PermanentMarker-Regular.wof.source: Permanent Marker by Font Diner, from the @fontsource/permanent-marker npm package (latin subset, unmodified)
public/fonts/PermanentMarker-Regular.wof.note: The marker face for the card-deck looks. Apache-2.0; the licence text is LICENSE-PermanentMarker.txt beside it. See src/fonts.ts.

public/fonts/LICENSE-PermanentMarker.txt.source: The LICENSE file from the @fontsource/permanent-marker npm package

public/music/egypt.mp3.source: "Desert Mystic 2" by PolygonDan, from the Desert_mystic pack, https://opengameart.org/content/desertmystic-dynastic-egyptian-theme-cc0
public/music/egypt.mp3.note: Listed CC0 by its author; the pack's own read-me says the songs are free to use with no licence restriction. Bed for the Cleopatra card-deck short, chosen by ear from four candidates. First 45 s, levelled to -26 LUFS and re-encoded by tools/music.sh (`npm run music`). Licence read on the track's page on 2026-11-10.

public/cutout/sunlight/rays.jpg.source: "Dramatic crepuscular rays in Australian suburbs", photograph by Commons user JaredMcKenzie, New South Wales, 6 February 2026 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dramatic_crepuscular_rays_in_Australian_suburbs.jpg
public/cutout/sunlight/rays.jpg.note: The photographer's own work, released CC0 on upload. A recent upload by an individual, so the dedication rests on the uploader's word alone. 1280px rendition. Fetched from Wikimedia Commons on 2026-11-10; licence as stated on the file's page that day.

public/cutout/sunlight/hand.jpg.source: "Man in hood stretching hand", photograph by Sandeep Swarnkar, published on Unsplash 9 April 2017 — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Man_in_hood_stretching_hand_(Unsplash).jpg
public/cutout/sunlight/hand.jpg.note: Commons records it as CC0: it went up on Unsplash in April 2017, before Unsplash replaced CC0 with its own licence that June. Only the hand is cut out and used. It is a real person's hand, face not shown: fine for editorial use like this. 1280px rendition. Fetched from Wikimedia Commons on 2026-11-10; licence as stated on the file's page that day.

public/cutout/sunlight/stereo.jpg.note: A NASA image, US federal government work. Only the disc is cut out and used. 1280px rendition. Fetched from Wikimedia Commons on 2026-11-10; licence as stated on the file's page that day.

public/cutout/sunlight/wheel.jpg.source: Collage of the Sun in different wavelengths from NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory, from "Sun Primer: Why NASA Scientists Observe the Sun in Different Wavelengths", January 2013, NASA/SDO/Goddard Space Flight Center — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sun_Primer-_Why_NASA_Scientists_Observe_the_Sun_in_Different_Wavelengths_(8407508991).jpg

public/cutout/sunlight/prominence.jpg.note: A NASA image, US federal government work. Commons also holds the same frame under another title tagged CC BY 2.0 from NASA Goddard's Flickr; this is the copy sourced from nasa.gov and tagged public domain. 1280px rendition. Fetched from Wikimedia Commons on 2026-11-10; licence as stated on the file's page that day.
